rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm check: rule9 exists so bold reliably signals a named handle; the categorical clause 'Kickers/koans/quotes never bold' protects that independent of the per-slide count. Located all 10 bold spans in the body fresh (grep -n '\*\*' over lines 1-83): line10 = the mandated check_pedagogy.md §34 task-sizing floor+ceiling callout in ## Prework, N/A by name. Lines20-23 = the ## What You'll Learn template's one-word bolded LO verbs, N/A by name. Lines72/74/76/78 = the reading-list-menu exception's mode-word-only bolds ('Read,'/'Watch,'/'Read,'/'Read (longer),'), title left plain each time, N/A by name. Line29 chunk4: '**The question, to you:** which task have you been putting off...' -- a bolded rhetorical address opening the room prompt. Not a named law/governor/coined-term/checklist-item; functionally a kicker (punchy lead-in before the actual question), which rule9 bans by category regardless of count -- chunk4 carries only this one bold, well inside the <=1 budget, so count is not the defect, kind is. Checked for an accept-note: grep -n 'kicker\|The question, to you\|Slide size accepted\|Slide deixis accepted' run-the-first-experiment.md -> only the flagged line itself, no accept-note. Ran fresh this pass: grep -n 'The question' getting-going.md plan-mode-done-right.md earn-the-trust.md -> identical bolded-kicker shape at getting-going.md:38 ('**The question (to you):**') and plan-mode-done-right.md:27 ('**The question, to you:**'); earn-the-trust.md:31 uses the identical phrase UNBOLDED ('The question, to you: what's the feature...'). Corpus-wide, inconsistently-applied pattern -- rule9 names only two carve-outs (§34 callouts, LO-bullet template) and this shape fits neither. The obvious fix (drop the bold) would not degrade the beat, so filed as a live TODO, not suppressed as a rule question. No other chunk in the file (including the new Optional-challenges chunk, which carries zero bold) trips this rule.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Unbold 'The question, to you:' and let it run as plain narrative, or -- since the identical bolded-kicker shape recurs verbatim in getting-going.md and plan-mode-done-right.md while earn-the-trust.md already runs it unbolded -- raise once as a corpus-wide question: name a third rule9 carve-out for this recurring module-opener kicker, or sweep-fix all three instances together.
